cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 and Icarus 13.0 run the initial procedures of a program in the active region set: a program reads design values before the design's nonblocking updates of the same time slot, its #0 resumes before the design's, and a flip-flop clocked by a program write runs before the program's #0 and its nonblocking update of the flip-flop's input.
